sources.name: PowerPyx · Roadmap
sources.use: single playthrough, 55 offline, cheats, manual saves

roadmap.name: Prologue & Chapter 1
roadmap.goal: Clear the opening missions and take the first meditation window before it closes.
roadmap.saves: Make a manual save before the Chapter 1 balcony meditation.

roadmap.name: Chapter 2 – Chapter 3
roadmap.goal: Bank chapter trophies, start stranger jobs and take Yago before its window shuts.
roadmap.saves: Save before the Cartel Heist and again before Chapter 3 ends.

roadmap.name: Chapter 4
roadmap.goal: Finish Headliners and VCIA Takedown, then open the full stranger strand set.
roadmap.saves: Use a manual save at the Chapter 4 boundary.

roadmap.name: Chapter 5 & Side Strands
roadmap.goal: Close the story, then grind the eight stranger strands and the tracked activity counts.
roadmap.saves: Keep a clean pre-finale save for cleanup.

roadmap.name: Cleanup & 100%
roadmap.goal: Finish remaining meditations, challenges, vaults, vehicles and oddities for A Long Road.
roadmap.saves: Keep 15 manual saves across the run as PowerPyx advises.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The seal on the ledger: every other trophy must be banked on the same save file before this one drops.

steps.text: Bank the other 54 trophies on one continuous save file.
Keep cheats off; they stop trophy credit being granted.
Finish the last story mission before the cleanup sweep.
Check the 55-name list against Exophase and PSNProfiles.
Let the platinum trigger on the final outstanding unlock.
Export the tracker once the seal appears on the list.

checks.text: Confirm no online trophy is required for the seal.

disputes.question: Is the platinum reachable in one playthrough?
disputes.positionA: PowerPyx plans one playthrough with no NG+ or replay.
disputes.positionB: Push Square's 250h estimate implies a longer cleanup tail.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Clear the opening mission, then bank the first chapter save before any side errands.

steps.text: Start Gone Fishing from the prologue marker on the map.
Follow the mission to its end card without cheats.
Note the trophy unlock among the prologue hints.
Make a manual save immediately after the end card.
Mark it in the Chapter 1 row of the ledger.
Cross-check the bronze grade on the PSN list.

checks.text: Verify the mission belongs to the prologue block.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every Chapter 1 mission in order; the chapter end card is the actual trigger.

steps.text: Track the Chapter 1 mission chain from the chapter table.
Play each mission in the listed order on one save.
Watch for the chapter completion card at the end.
Take a manual save before leaving the chapter behind.
Log the unlock in the story filter of the tracker.
Confirm the bronze grade against Exophase.

checks.text: Check the chapter boundary against the mission map.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 2 mission chain; keep a spare save before the chapter's last job.

steps.text: Open the Chapter 2 block in the chapter table.
Work through the missions in the mapped order.
Avoid cheats so the chapter card still counts.
Save manually before the final Chapter 2 job.
Tick the trophy once the chapter card appears.
Verify the exact masked name on the PSN list.

checks.text: Keep the asterisks exactly as PlayStation prints them.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Clear Chapter 3, including the Cartel Heist, and check the Yago window before the chapter ends.

steps.text: Follow the Chapter 3 mission chain to its card.
Complete the Cartel Heist when the mission opens.
Take the Yago race before the chapter closes.
Save before the heist so a retry stays cheap.
Log the chapter trophy in the tracker.
Cross-check the grade on two trophy indexes.

checks.text: Note that Break the Bank is the Cartel Heist reward.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 4 chain and let the chapter end card register the trophy.

steps.text: Read the Chapter 4 mission table before starting.
Play Headliners and VCIA Takedown in sequence.
Stay clear of cheats through the chapter card.
Make a manual save at the Chapter 4 boundary.
Tick the chapter row once the card appears.
Verify the bronze grade against Exophase.

checks.text: Confirm the chapter mapping with the mission table.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission cleanly; this is one of only two golds, so keep a save before the trigger.

steps.text: Read the final mission prerequisites in the chapter map.
Clear every earlier mission before the finale unlocks.
Keep a manual save outside the final mission.
Play the finale through to its end card without cheats.
Check that the gold appears on the trophy list.
Mark the gold in the tracker before cleanup.

checks.text: Confirm this gold is paired with A Long Road.

disputes.question: Does the finale gold depend on dialogue choices?
disputes.positionA: Sources map the gold strictly to completing the final mission.
disputes.positionB: Some checklists imply a choice gate near the ending.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish Breakfast Run when it appears; it is a short chapter job with no long prerequisite chain.

steps.text: Locate Breakfast Run in the mission table.
Start it as soon as the marker becomes active.
Complete the objective through to the end card.
Save after the mission before other side jobs.
Tick the mission trophy in the tracker.
Cross-check the bronze grade on the PSN list.

checks.text: Confirm the mission's chapter placement in the map.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist in Chapter 3 earns this trophy; save before the heist so a failed attempt is cheap.

steps.text: Match the trophy name to The Cartel Heist mission.
Start the heist from the Chapter 3 mission chain.
Save a clean attempt before entering the vault area.
Finish the heist and watch for the trophy pop.
Log the unlock in the story filter.
Verify the exact description and grade.

checks.text: Use the Chapter 3 guide to confirm the mission title.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Child's Play sits in Chapter 4; clear it alongside the other chapter missions for a smooth route.

steps.text: Find Child's Play in the Chapter 4 mission table.
Follow the Chapter 4 route to the mission marker.
Complete the mission to its end card.
Save at the chapter boundary afterwards.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Confirm the official wording on Exophase.

checks.text: Cross-check the Chapter 4 assignment with another guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Headliners is the Chapter 4 mission behind this trophy; finish it before the VCIA job.

steps.text: Identify Headliners as the Chapter 4 source mission.
Play it before the VCIA Takedown marker opens.
Keep cheats disabled for the whole mission.
Save after the end card and before the next job.
Mark the unlock in the chapter ledger.
Check the grade against the PSN table.

checks.text: Confirm the mission mapping on a second index.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown closes out Chapter 4's mission pair; save before it if you also want the escape oddity.

steps.text: Read the Chapter 4 map entry for VCIA Takedown.
Clear Headliners first so the marker is live.
Take a manual save before the takedown begins.
Finish the mission to trigger the bronze.
Log it before starting the airport oddity.
Verify name and grade on Exophase.

checks.text: Keep the pre-mission save for Catch Me If You Can.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory is the Chapter 5 mission tied to this trophy; finish the chain to claim it.

steps.text: Locate Operation Savage Glory in the Chapter 5 table.
Work through the Chapter 5 chain to reach it.
Complete the mission without cheats for credit.
Save at the end of the chapter.
Tick the trophy in the story filter.
Confirm the description on the official PSN list.

checks.text: Check the chapter assignment against the mission map.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The completion gold needs every category closed; treat it as the final ledger item after all cleanup.

steps.text: List every completion category from the 100% checklist.
Close story, stranger and collectible categories first.
Finish the 70 challenge and 18 meditation targets.
Sweep remaining vaults, vehicles and random oddities.
Watch the completion percentage reach its final value.
Record the gold once the percentage locks.

checks.text: Reconcile the category list across two checklists.

disputes.question: What exactly counts toward 100% completion?
disputes.positionA: Checklists group story, collectibles, challenges and activities.
disputes.positionB: Some guides treat optional random events as separate.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Bank stunts naturally while driving between jobs, then finish the last few in a focused session.

steps.text: Read the official tracked target of 250 stunts.
Take ramps and jumps while driving to story jobs.
Vary stunt types so repeats do not stall progress.
Cluster the last attempts near a reliable ramp.
Check the in-game counter before a final run.
Verify the silver grade on the trophy list.

checks.text: Keep a save before the last stunt batch.

disputes.question: Are all stunts counted the same?
disputes.positionA: The description tracks 250 completed stunts.
disputes.positionB: Checklists sometimes separate unique stunt types.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once; use the activity board to see which categories remain untouched.

steps.text: Open the activity board and list its categories.
Play one round of each distinct activity type.
Do not worry about winning for this bronze.
Track tried types in the checklist module.
Finish the last untried type to pop the trophy.
Confirm the grade against the PSN table.

checks.text: Recheck the category count on a second checklist.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold every Shooting Range challenge; the tracked set is 42, so work range by range.

steps.text: Confirm the tracked challenge count of 42.
Read the medal thresholds before each run.
Gold the challenges in one range before moving on.
Retry a missed medal with a clean save.
Tick the final gold in the tracker.
Verify the silver grade against Exophase.

checks.text: Compare the 42 figure with the challenge checklist.

disputes.question: Are all 42 range challenges required for gold?
disputes.positionA: Exophase and Game Checklists track 42 challenges.
disputes.positionB: One guide counts only the medal tiers in a subset.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win each drone race location in turn; mark them off so the last circuit is obvious.

steps.text: List the drone race markers from the checklist.
Win one race at each listed location.
Re-run a venue if the first win did not register.
Group nearby venues into one driving loop.
Mark the last win in the tracker.
Confirm the bronze grade on the PSN list.

checks.text: Cross-check the location list with another checklist.

disputes.question: How many drone race locations are there?
disputes.positionA: Guide trackers list every marked drone race venue.
disputes.positionB: Completion checklists differ on whether variants count.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win twenty distinct races; rotate venues so duplicate runs do not pad the counter.

steps.text: Verify the official target of twenty wins.
Enter a different race each time you compete.
Take wins while driving between other objectives.
Keep a short list of already-won venues.
Finish the twentieth distinct win.
Check the bronze grade after the pop.

checks.text: Reconcile the count with the checklist module.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Take Cal's fishing challenge and win it cleanly; the trophy follows the result screen.

steps.text: Find Cal's fishing challenge on the map.
Accept the challenge from the marked contact.
Beat Cal's score before the timer expires.
Save afterwards in case a retry is needed.
Tick the activity in the tracker.
Confirm the bronze grade on the list.

checks.text: Cross-check the challenge name with the guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Finish one full arcade game; a single completed run is enough for the bronze.

steps.text: Locate an arcade cabinet on the activity map.
Start a game and play through to its results.
A loss still counts if the game finishes.
Save after the result screen.
Mark the bronze in the tracker.
Verify the trophy grade against Exophase.

checks.text: Check the activity type in the 100% list.

disputes.question: Must an arcade game be won?
disputes.positionA: The description asks only to complete one.
disputes.positionB: Some guides say finish with a win.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Andy's stranger strand ends with this mission; complete the last job in his chain.

steps.text: Find Andy's strand in the eight-strand list.
Work through his jobs in the listed order.
Complete the final mission for Andy.
Save once the strand closes.
Tick the strand in the tracker.
Confirm the grade on the PSN list.

checks.text: Count this strand toward the eight-strand trophy.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Kenton's final stranger mission is the target; finish his whole chain before the last job.

steps.text: Locate Kenton's strand among the eight.
Follow the strand jobs in the guide order.
Finish the final mission for Kenton.
Save after the strand end card.
Mark the completion in the tracker.
Check the bronze grade on Exophase.

checks.text: Verify the strand is part of the full set.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Billy's chain ends here; keep the strand order straight so the final marker appears.

steps.text: Identify Billy's strand in the stranger table.
Play each Billy job in sequence.
Complete his final mission for the bronze.
Save before leaving the area.
Tick the strand in the ledger.
Cross-check the grade with the PSN table.

checks.text: Confirm the strand is one of the eight.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish all eight full stranger strands; the individual end trophies are good checkpoints.

steps.text: List the eight complete strands from the guide.
Count Andy, Kenton, Billy and the other named chains.
Work one strand through to its end before switching.
Use the individual end trophies as progress markers.
Finish the eighth strand for the silver.
Verify the grade on the PSN list.

checks.text: Cross-check the strand total with a second guide.

disputes.question: Do partial strands count toward eight?
disputes.positionA: gta.guide describes eight full strands.
disputes.positionB: One tracker counts any eight stranger missions.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Randy's last stranger mission completes his strand; finish the earlier jobs first.

steps.text: Find Randy's strand entry in the guide.
Clear the preceding Randy jobs in order.
Finish the final mission for Randy.
Save at the strand end card.
Mark the bronze in the tracker.
Confirm the official description on Exophase.

checks.text: Count the strand toward the silver trophy.

disputes.question: Is Randy one of the eight full strands?
disputes.positionA: gta.guide names Randy among the stranger chains.
disputes.positionB: One tracker groups his jobs as a side mission.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Tyrone's chain closes the last listed strand; finish it to complete the eight-strand set.

steps.text: Locate Tyrone's strand in the eight-strand table.
Play his jobs in the recorded order.
Finish the final mission for Tyrone.
Save after the last strand end card.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Verify the grade on the trophy table.

checks.text: Use this as the eighth strand checkpoint.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all eighteen spots; take the Chapter 1 balcony spot early because sources disagree on its window.

steps.text: Check the eighteen meditation spots in the register.
Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation during that chapter.
Save manually before leaving Chapter 1.
Meditate at remaining spots as they become reachable.
Track your count with the plus and minus controls.
Finish the last spot and verify the bronze.

checks.text: Cross-check the eighteen total with another tracker.

trophies.window: Chapter 1 balcony spot: do it before the chapter closes.

disputes.question: Is the Chapter 1 meditation truly missable?
disputes.positionA: PowerPyx calls Positive Mental Attitude possible-missable in Chapter 1.
disputes.positionB: BestGTA6 lists it among missables while output trackers treat all spots as revisitable.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Bret's hunting request needs the unique animal; follow his 15-target hunt chain to the special kill.

steps.text: Check the 100-animal target in the register.
Accept Bret's hunting requests from his contact.
Work through his fifteen hunts in order.
Take the unique animal when Bret flags it.
Save after the special kill.
Verify the bronze on the PSN list.

checks.text: Count this animal within the hundred target.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three full card sets; trade duplicates and use the card map to finish sets efficiently.

steps.text: Read the card set list and pick three targets.
Collect cards from the mapped locations.
Trade duplicates to complete missing slots.
Mark each finished set in the tracker.
Complete the third set to trigger the silver.
Cross-check the grade on the PSN table.

checks.text: Verify that three means full sets, not three cards.

disputes.question: Does the trophy need three full sets or three cards?
disputes.positionA: The official wording says three Collectible Card sets.
disputes.positionB: Some checklists shorthand it as three collected sets.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK at one hundred locations; fold the scans into driving routes between other objectives.

steps.text: Confirm the official target of one hundred scans.
Scan WAiNK points while driving between jobs.
Use the collectible map to avoid repeat locations.
Keep a running tally in the tracker.
Perform scan one hundred.
Verify the silver grade on Exophase.

checks.text: Cross-check the count against another collector.

disputes.question: Do repeat scans advance the hundred count?
disputes.positionA: Checklists describe one hundred distinct locations.
disputes.positionB: Some players count any repeated scan action.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete fifty of the available challenges; the wider list runs to seventy or eighty depending on the source.

steps.text: Confirm the trophy needs fifty completed challenges.
Choose the easiest fifty from the challenge list.
Finish challenges in clusters by district.
Mark each completion in the checklist.
Finish challenge number fifty.
Check the bronze grade against Exophase.

checks.text: Compare the available challenge total across sources.

disputes.question: How many challenges exist in total?
disputes.positionA: gta.guide counts seventy challenges available.
disputes.positionB: Other checklists list up to eighty.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, draw a four-star wanted level and lose it together.

steps.text: Check the official four-star condition in the list.
Have your partner with you before raising heat.
Reach four stars and drive away as a pair.
Break line of sight until the wanted level clears.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Verify the exact description on the PSN list.

checks.text: Make sure both characters survive the escape.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops in one continuous chain with your partner, keeping the wanted level alive between them.

steps.text: Read the back-to-back condition in the description.
Bring your partner before the first shop.
Rob the first shop and keep moving fast.
Hit two more shops before the heat clears.
Mark the bronze in the tracker.
Confirm the grade on the PSN table.

checks.text: Pick three close shops to keep the chain alive.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover one hundred vehicles; the wider completion target is two hundred, so this is the first milestone.

steps.text: Confirm the first milestone is one hundred vehicles.
Drive a new model each time you travel.
Use the vehicle list to avoid duplicates.
Track discovered models in the ledger.
Reach the hundredth discovery.
Verify the bronze grade.

checks.text: Note that completion eventually tracks two hundred.

disputes.question: Does discovery mean-driving or owning?
disputes.positionA: Official wording says discover one hundred vehicles.
disputes.positionB: Completion checklists sometimes count owned garage slots.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Save Combat Focus for a group of five enemies, then tag and down them inside one activation.

steps.text: Check the single-activation rule in the description.
Find a cluster of at least five enemies.
Activate Combat Focus and tag each target.
Down all five before the focus ends.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Confirm the exact wording on Exophase.

checks.text: Retry at another encounter if the fifth is missed.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Use the pre-VCIA save to attempt the unscheduled departure; this is one of the at-risk airport oddities.

steps.text: Read the airport window in the missable register.
Save before starting VCIA Takedown.
Try the unscheduled departure during the mission.
Reload the save if the door option is gone.
Tick the bronze once the pop appears.
Verify the exact name on Exophase.

disputes.question: Is the VCIA departure only possible during the mission?
disputes.positionA: Missable lists tie it to the VCIA Takedown window.
disputes.positionB: Some checklists treat it as a free-roam airport interaction.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The Rhinos line points to the tank encounter; handle it during the available window and keep a save.

steps.text: Check the tank oddity in the cleanup register.
Save before approaching the Rhino encounter.
Trigger the tank event during its available window.
Complete the encounter to earn the bronze.
Mark it in the tracker.
Confirm the grade against Exophase.

trophies.window: Story-linked tank encounter; save before triggering.

disputes.question: Is the tank encounter a fixed story event?
disputes.positionA: Cleanup routes place it in the story-linked window.
disputes.positionB: Free-roam checklists list it as always available.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Plan a clean jewelry store robbery: enter unseen and leave before an alarm identifies you.

steps.text: Read the undetected condition in the description.
Pick a jewelry store with a quiet approach.
Save just before entering the store.
Rob it without raising a wanted level.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Verify the exact grade on Exophase.

trophies.window: Any jewelry store robbery; save before entry.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob and escape five vaults; the wider completion register counts eight, so five is the trophy threshold.

steps.text: Confirm the trophy threshold is five vaults.
Check the eight-vault total in the register.
Save before each vault attempt.
Escape after the fifth successful vault.
Mark the silver in the tracker.
Verify the grade on the PSN table.

disputes.question: Are five or eight vaults needed?
disputes.positionA: The trophy description says five vaults and escape.
disputes.positionB: Completion checklists count eight vaults overall.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Stop an armored truck, take the cargo and get away; a clean pre-attempt save helps with retries.

steps.text: Check the armored truck entry in the checklist.
Save before intercepting a truck.
Stop the truck and take the cargo.
Escape the pursuit to trigger the bronze.
Mark it in the tracker.
Confirm the grade on Exophase.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Fill in every mapped area of Leonida; the exploration grid is a slow drift best handled during routing.

steps.text: Read the exploration requirement in the description.
Open the map and note unexplored sectors.
Drive through each remaining sector.
Let the map reveal settle before moving on.
Finish the final sector for the bronze.
Cross-check the grade with the PSN list.

disputes.question: How many areas make up all of Leonida?
disputes.positionA: One checklist counts a fixed set of named districts.
disputes.positionB: Another counts any map sector that reveals.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Hit one illegal operation for every gang; use the gang operation total as a checklist rather than assuming a small set.

steps.text: Check the gang operation total in the register.
List the gangs with an illegal operation.
Rob one operation for each gang.
Mark each gang off in the tracker.
Finish the last gang operation.
Verify the bronze grade against Exophase.

disputes.question: Does each gang need one operation or all of them?
disputes.positionA: The description says one operation belonging to each gang.
disputes.positionB: Completion lists track a much larger set of operations.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: The cryptic description points to an early Ocean Beach cocktail; treat it as a windowed oddity and save first.

steps.text: Read the Ocean Beach clue in the missable register.
Save before the early chapter where the view opens.
Take the cocktail at the Ocean Beach viewpoint.
Watch for the trophy pop on the result.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Confirm the exact ellipsis in the name.

trophies.window: Early Ocean Beach visit; save before the chapter closes.

disputes.question: Is the cocktail locked to an early chapter?
disputes.positionA: Missable registers place it in the opening window.
disputes.positionB: Other lists treat it as a free-roam location.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive through a vehicle showroom in a dramatic exit; the phrasing suggests a scripted or specific stunt trigger.

steps.text: Read the showroom clue in the trophy description.
Save before trying the showroom exit.
Enter a vehicle showroom and build speed.
Smash out through the display in classic style.
Mark the bronze in the tracker.
Verify the grade on the PSN table.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Bowl at the Kolt & Associates alley and finish with a follow-through; sources differ on whether the trigger is story-linked.

steps.text: Check the Ch1 balcony and alley note in the guide.
Save before approaching the bowling alley.
Play a frame at Kolt & Associates.
Hold the follow-through until the pop appears.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Verify the exact curved apostrophe in the name.

trophies.window: Kolt & Associates alley; possibly Chapter 1 linked.

disputes.question: Is bowling tied to a story chapter?
disputes.positionA: One guide places the alley trigger in Chapter 1.
disputes.positionB: Leonida Interactive marks the trigger unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The vague wording points to a partner-based popularity milestone; check both characters before assuming a single trigger.

steps.text: Read the partnership clue on the PSN list.
Raise both characters' public profile.
Trigger the mass-appeal milestone with your partner.
Save after the event resolves.
Mark the bronze in the tracker.
Confirm the exact description on Exophase.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: This tracks accumulated choices; keep making story and side decisions and the counter will advance.

steps.text: Check the tracked choice counter on Exophase.
Make choices in story missions as they appear.
Take side-job decisions instead of skipping them.
Track your own tally in the ledger.
Reach the final counted choice.
Verify the bronze grade on the list.

disputes.question: How many choices does the counter require?
disputes.positionA: Trackers list a hidden counter that climbs with decisions.
disputes.positionB: Some checklists round the target differently.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: A retry reward: fail once at the relevant action, then succeed on the second attempt.

steps.text: Read the second-chance clue in the description.
Attempt the related action once and fail.
Save at the failure point if possible.
Succeed on the immediate second attempt.
Tick the bronze in the tracker.
Verify the grade against Exophase.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The UFO-style oddity in the cleanup route; follow the strange-event lead rather than the main missions.

steps.text: Check the UFO cleanup note in the route.
Save before chasing the strange event.
Follow the oddity lead to its final moment.
Watch for the mysterious-event pop.
Mark the bronze in the tracker.
